eligibility.reason: E1/E4: maintainer-reported observed near-limit motion failure and corrective commit. E2 stops at 6: wrong URDF limits supplied by the support package are accepted by the separately deployed MoveIt consumer, creating invalid plans. This is a numeric interface value error rather than deployment wiring. E3: PAIR.
eligibility.quote: MoveIt exploited the tiny bit of extra space, while the robot (correctly) returned an error, refusing to complete the motion.

failed_conditions.reason: Both sides use radians; the defect is excessive numeric position bounds rather than unit_mismatch or representation_convention. other and param:/robot_description correctly identify the condition and transport.
failed_conditions.quote: It would appear the values in the urdf are _rounded up_, while they should'be been either _floored_ or written out with more digits.

Restricting conditions to the three joints in the opening report omits this primary code-level evidence. No separate failed-motion observation is claimed for those extra bounds.
